# Canopy

> Canopy is a community app store for umbrelOS (Umbrel). It ships apps that Umbrel's official store doesn't have, plus apps that other community stores ship out of date. Every app is pinned to an exact upstream release, checked for new versions daily, and installed and tested before an update ships. It is the home of YAMS, a media server (Jellyfin, Sonarr, Radarr, Prowlarr, Bazarr, qBittorrent behind a VPN) that comes already wired together.

To add it: in Umbrel, open App Store → ⋯ → Community App Stores and paste https://github.com/Deepshah0308/canopy-umbrel-store

Canopy never duplicates an app from Umbrel's official store. It is MIT licensed and not made by Umbrel.

## Docs

- [Website and app list](https://canopystore.app/): every app with its current version and last update
- [Apps as JSON](https://canopystore.app/apps.json): id, name, version, category and last update for every app, always current
- [Install Canopy](https://canopystore.app/guide/install/): add the store to Umbrel, updates, troubleshooting, removal
- [Apps and store rules](https://canopystore.app/guide/apps/): what each app does, its port, and how updates are tested
- [FAQ](https://canopystore.app/guide/faq/)
- [Security](https://canopystore.app/guide/security/): how apps are packaged and how to report a problem
- [Changelog](https://canopystore.app/guide/changelog/)
- [Contributing](https://canopystore.app/guide/contributing/): how to add or fix an app

## YAMS

- [YAMS overview](https://canopystore.app/guide/yams/): Jellyfin, Sonarr, Radarr, Prowlarr, Bazarr and qBittorrent behind a VPN in one install
- [What YAMS sets up for you](https://canopystore.app/guide/yams/automatic/)
- [Extras](https://canopystore.app/guide/yams/extras/): Seerr, Lidarr, Recyclarr, Unpackerr, Decluttarr
- [Managing YAMS](https://canopystore.app/guide/yams/managing/): backups, quick fixes, searching through the VPN, updates
- [Hardware transcoding](https://canopystore.app/guide/yams/transcoding/): Intel, AMD and NVIDIA on umbrelOS 2.1+
- [How YAMS fits together](https://canopystore.app/guide/yams/how-it-works/)
- [Troubleshooting YAMS](https://canopystore.app/guide/yams/troubleshooting/)
- [Source code](https://github.com/Deepshah0308/canopy-umbrel-store)
